title: Trajectories of Change: Vocabulary, Citation-Identity, and Embedding-Density Measures for Publication Trajectories
description: Trajectories of Change is a research package for comparing author- and field-level publication trajectories using Own- and Referenced-Vocabulary KLD, outgoing Citation-Identity KLD, and Embedding Density Estimation (EDE) on publication/reference Parquet datasets. It provides a Python API, CLI, optional plotting helpers, deterministic synthetic example data, and a canonical two-Parquet data contract with optional provenance sidecars. The four measures are applied to the history of general relativity and gravitation in Schlattmann and Vogl, "Tracing individual knowledge trajectories in a changing field: the case of general relativity and gravitation" (Frontiers in Complex Systems, accepted 16 November 2026).
